test_FolderFunction: test FolderFunction by creating a parametrized function from a folder with NG_ARG placeholders and running it
test_FolderInstantiator: test FolderInstantiator by instantiating a folder with placeholder values into a temporary directory
test_Placeholder_finditer: test Placeholder.finditer to extract all NG_ARG placeholder tokens and their comments from text
test_Placeholder_sub: test Placeholder.sub to replace NG_ARG tokens in text with provided values for a given file extension
test_symlink_folder_tree: test symlink_folder_tree to create a lightweight symlink copy of a folder tree structure
